title: HardFloor Canister Vacuum Cleaner, 1989D by  OptiClean BISSELL
text:
HardFloor Canister Vacuum Cleaner, 1989D by OptiClean BISSELL. Not so red hot. Maybe because it is a 9 amp and not a 10? The 11 inch head just doesn't pick up like my [[ASIN:B008LX6OC6 iRobot Roomba 650 Robot Vacuum]] or our [[ASIN:B00SWCU1HU Hoover Vacuum Cleaner Air Lift 20 Volt Lithium Ion Cordless Bagless Upright Vacuum BH51120PC]] and definitely not as good as [[ASIN:B00IOD354I Samsung MotionSync Bagless Upright Vacuum with Detachable Handheld Vac and Built-In Accessories - Refined Wine - Corded]].It works fine on not carpeted floors like tile and wood and vinyl so if you have big areas that can handle the big head this is the perfect tool. The canister design is perfect. and once they come up with a 25 foot cord my whole house can be cleaned without needing to stop and move to a closer outlet - now THAT is winning.

I didn't find the 1989d on the Bissel homepage but it seems similar to the 1535 model.

product_metadata.title: BISSELL OptiClean HardFloor and Area Rug Canister Vacuum Cleaner, 1989D, Purple/Black
features: Cyclonic technology provides powerful suction for thorough cleaning
Turbo tool for cleaning above floors on upholstery, stairs and more areas
Easy empty dirt tank bottom empty dirt bin designed for easy and touch less dirt disposal
Compact and lightweight easy to use and store
Multi-Surface Floor Tool is great for hard floors as well as low pile carpet and area rugs
description: The BISSELL Opticlean canister vacuum makes it easy to take powerful mess removal from one room in your home to another. It features cyclonic technology that gives you continuous, powerful suction across multiple floor surfaces. The compact design makes it easy to store and the lightweight design and swivel steering make maneuvering around furniture and between rooms a snap. The easy empty dirt tank provides for bottom emptying to keep dirt off your hands. The included tools and telescopic wand let you clean those hard-to-reach areas of your home with ease.
